latest.notes: Continuous overnight log: the on-air player now keeps a rolling window of the current day PLUS the next day, so programming flows across midnight with no handoff. The next day's real hours (legal ID, imaging, music) are simply the tail of the queue and play gaplessly the moment the current day ends — no music-only filler, no idle, no 30-minute catch-up. The primary day slides forward on its own once the current day has fully aired.
